 C -- Cloud Security Engineering Support for FedRAMP 20x Package Review This requirement supports the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) Program Management Office’s (PMO) review and assessment of FedRAMP cloud service offerings. Contractor support will assist the Government in evaluating submitted materials identifying deficiencies and risks and preparing findings and recommendations while preserving the Government’s exclusive authority over policy interpretation risk acceptance certification and FedRAMP Marketplace decisions. For more information about this opportunity please contact the buyer directly.
